CIRCLE_LOW_SATISFACTION_GRIEVANCE.en: Circle satisfaction is low — a grievance exists

CIRCLE_UNCIRCLED_MEMBER.en: Not part of any Imperial Circle

CIRCLE_WAR_CALL_DEFENSIVE_WAR.en: Circle is defending against a non-HRE aggressor

HRE_CIRCLE_FORMATION_DESC.en: The Imperial Diet is forming Imperial Circles. Each member must join a Circle before the deadline.

HRE_CIRCLE_FORMATION_END_DATE.en: End Date of the Formation Period

HRE_CIRCLE_MAX_CAP_REACHED.en: This circle has reached its maximum voting power.

HRE_CIRCLE_SATISFACTION_TT_IMPACT.en: Higher satisfaction improves [prestige|e] and [diplomatic_reputation|e] for the Circle Leader.\n#Y < 30#! — Circle members are discontent. The Circle Leader may face challenges.\n#R < 15#! — Circle members may openly challenge the leader's authority.

HRE_CIRCLE_TOTAL_VOTE_POWER.en: The combined Imperial Diet vote power of this circle is #G +[InternationalOrganizationsView.GetCircleTotalParliamentVotes(Country.Self)|0]#!

INCOMING_OFFER_appeal_to_circle_diet.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] requests financial aid being granted to them. Accepting will grant them a fifth of our yearly income and will make them appear more legitimate. Rejecting this proposal will lower the satisfaction of our circle.\n\n$INFO$

INCOMING_OFFER_appeal_to_emperor.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] appeals to us to intervene in their Imperial Circle's leadership dispute. Accepting will reduce their circle's satisfaction by 8, penalize the circle leader's prestige, and grant us prestige and Imperial Authority.\n\n$INFO$

INCOMING_OFFER_call_imperial_circle_to_w.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] calls upon us to bring our circle's armies to their war.\n\n$INFO$

INCOMING_OFFER_petition_imperial_diet.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] brings a petition before us at the Imperial Diet.\n\n$INFO$

INCOMING_OFFER_request_circle_infrastruc.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] requests expansion of their military. Accepting allows them to focus on bolstering their road connections and building construction, while in turn lowering their military capabilities for a the next 10 years.\n\n$INFO$

INCOMING_OFFER_request_circle_privilege.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] requests a special privilege for their Imperial Circle.\n\n$INFO$

INCOMING_OFFER_request_new_circle_titles.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] demands the elevation of their country within our Circle. Accepting would satisfy their nobles and give them a more prestigious position.\n\n$INFO$

appeal_to_circle_diet.en: Request Financial Grant from Circle Diet

appeal_to_circle_diet_desc.en: Request a new financial grant from our Circle Leader.

appeal_to_circle_diet_timeout_tt.en: No country has used the  $appeal_to_circle_diet$ [diplomatic_action|e] in the last 2 years

appeal_to_emperor_act.en: Appeal to the Emperor to intervene in your circle's leadership dispute.

appeal_to_emperor_desc.en: Appeal to the Emperor to intervene in your circle's leadership dispute.

appoint_imperial_circle_leader_desc.en: Use Imperial authority to appoint a leader for a circle that currently lacks one.

approve_imperial_circle_proposal_act.en: Whip [SCOPE.sImperialCircle('target').GetName] to vote for the proposal.

approve_imperial_circle_proposal_desc.en: As Circle Leader, lock every member of this circle (including ourselves) into voting for the proposal currently before the Imperial Diet. No payment is required, but the lock holds until the resolution closes.

approve_imperial_circle_proposal_effect_.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] whip [SCOPE.sImperialCircle('target').GetName] to vote for the imperial proposal.
[SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] whipped [SCOPE.sImperialCircle('target').GetName] to vote for the imperial proposal.

approve_imperial_circle_proposal_members.en: Every member of [SCOPE.sImperialCircle('target').GetName] has their [vote|e] in the active Imperial Diet proposal locked to the proposed policy.

bribe_imperial_circle_act.en: Bribe [SCOPE.sCountry('target').GetName] to back our Diet proposal.

bribe_imperial_circle_desc.en: Pay an Imperial Circle Leader and every member of their circle to vote for our proposal at the Imperial Diet. The Circle Leader receives the full base bribe, and every other member receives 25% of that amount. Every member's vote is locked behind the Emperor's pick until the resolution closes.

bribe_imperial_circle_effect_text.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] bribe [SCOPE.sCountry('target').GetName]'s circle to back the imperial proposal.

bribe_imperial_circle_effect_text_past.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] bribed [SCOPE.sCountry('target').GetName]'s circle to back the imperial proposal.

bribe_imperial_circle_members_tt.en: Each other member of [SCOPE.sCountry('target').GetName]'s circle receives [SCOPE.GetValue('bribe_member_share')|0V]@gold! and has their [vote|e] in the active Imperial Diet proposal locked to the Emperor's pick.

call_imperial_circle_to_war_act.en: Call [SCOPE.sCountry('recipient').GetName]'s circle to join the war.

call_imperial_circle_to_war_desc.en: Call upon a Circle Leader to bring their circle's military support to your current war.

challenge_circle_leadership_act.en: Challenge the current Circle Leader's authority.

challenge_circle_leadership_desc.en: Our current Circle leaders have proven themselves to be unworthy of the position and the responsibility. We have the opportunity to put their power into question and undermine their authority, which can lead to their hold weaken even more, or to open opposition directly.

challenge_circle_leadership_tt.en:
We win the challenge in any of the following cases:
  • Our circle's satisfaction is below 15 — open revolt
  • Our circle's satisfaction is below 30 and our prestige is at least as high as theirs
  • Our prestige exceeds theirs by 25 or more

Losing or withdrawing costs prestige. A newly installed leader is immune to challenges for 2 years.

demand_circle_loyalty_act.en: Assert your authority over your circle members.

demand_circle_loyalty_desc.en: Assert our authority over our circle members. We gain prestige and diplomatic standing for 3 years, but members resent the imposition and the circle's satisfaction drops.

demand_circle_loyalty_tt.en: We gain [ShowModifier('imposed_circle_authority')] for 3 years. Each non-leader member of our [imperial_circle|e] gains [ShowModifier('pressured_circle_loyalty')] for 3 years and [ShowBiasValue('opinion_demanded_loyalty')|+=2] [opinion|e] of us. The Circle's satisfaction drops by 5.

distribute_imperial_grant_act.en: Distribute gold to your circle members.

distribute_imperial_grant_desc.en: Distribute gold from your treasury to your circle members, improving relations and circle satisfaction.

distribute_imperial_grant_effect_text.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] distribute an Imperial Grant to their circle.

distribute_imperial_grant_effect_text_pa.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] distributed an Imperial Grant to their circle.

distribute_imperial_grant_tt.en: We spend [SCOPE.GetValue('total_grant')|2V]@gold! (20% of our [economical_base|e]), distributed equally among non-leader members of our [imperial_circle|e]. Each recipient gains [ShowModifier('received_imperial_circle_grant')] for 2 years and [ShowBiasValue('opinion_received_imperial_grant')|+=2] [opinion|e] of us.

hre_circle_levy_request_desc.en: Request that the Imperial Circles raise levies for the Empire. Circle leaders are rewarded for their cooperation.

hre_enforce_circle_landfriede_desc.en: Empower Circle Leaders to enforce the Imperial peace within their territories.

imperial_circles.1.a.en: For the glory of the Empire!

imperial_circles.1.desc.en: The formation period has concluded. The Imperial Circles have been locked in place and their leaders will govern the Empire's affairs. A new chapter begins for the Holy Roman Empire.

imperial_circles.11.a.en: Distribute emergency funds to ease tensions.

imperial_circles.11.b.en: Let them complain — we have larger concerns.

imperial_circles.11.desc.en: Our circle members are growing restless. If we do not act soon, our authority as Circle Leader may be openly challenged.

imperial_circles.12.a.en: We must act before it is too late.

imperial_circles.12.desc.en: The frustration within the circle has reached a breaking point. Our members are openly questioning our leadership. An election may be imminent.

imperial_circles.2.a.en: They are right, we should distribute it now.

imperial_circles.2.b.en: They are mistaken, no such bribery existed.

imperial_circles.2.desc.en: In the recent Imperial Diet, our Circle has supported the proposed reform of the Imperial Constitution. This support has come with the common understanding among members of our circle that we, as the leader of the Circle, would distribute funds between them. Justified or not, our failure to act upon these expectations has lead to several complaints about our abuse of power, withholding funds intended for the circles members. If we do not act upon these complaints, this could seriously harm our leadership in the future.

imperial_circles.20.a.en: The gold will not be refused.

imperial_circles.20.desc.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] has paid the leader of our Imperial Circle, [SCOPE.sCountry('target').GetName], to back the proposal currently before the Imperial Diet. We have received [SCOPE.GetValue('received_bribe')|0V]@gold! as our share, and our [vote|e] in the active resolution is now locked behind the Emperor's pick until it closes.

imperial_circles.50.desc.en: We have come forward to challenge [recipient.GetName] for the leadership of our Imperial Circle.\n\nTheir weakness and negligence can no longer be tolerated, and there are many that would surely stand behind us in our complains. If we manage to present ourselves as a clear better and stronger leader, they will fold to our demands, but failing to do so will undoubtedly hurt how we are perceived not only by foreign countries but by our people too.

imperial_circles.51.a.en: This humiliation will not be forgotten.

imperial_circles.51.desc.en: A rival has successfully challenged our leadership. We have been stripped of the Circle Leader title and must rebuild our standing within the circle.

imperial_circles.52.a.en: Our authority is not so easily broken.

imperial_circles.52.desc.en: A challenger tried to unseat us but their prestige proved insufficient. Our position as Circle Leader remains secure.

imperial_circles.53.desc.en: Our challenge against [recipient.GetName] for leadership of our Imperial Circle has failed. Our prestige did not measure up against theirs, and our standing has suffered for the attempt. We must wait before pressing the matter again.

imperial_circles.70.a.en: We shall lead the circle with distinction.

imperial_circles.70.desc.en: With the previous leader no longer among our ranks, the circle has looked to us to assume leadership. We are now the Circle Leader.

imperial_circles.71.desc.en: One of the Imperial Circles has been left without a qualified candidate to assume leadership. The Emperor's authority is undermined when circles go ungoverned.

imperial_circles.80.desc.en: We now wear the Imperial Crown. As Emperor, we cannot simultaneously hold the role of Circle Leader — the two offices demand undivided loyalty. We relinquish our circle leadership so another may step forward.

join_an_imperial_circle_desc.en: Join an Imperial Circle during the formation period.

oppose_imperial_circle_proposal_act.en: Whip [SCOPE.sImperialCircle('target').GetName] to vote against the proposal.

oppose_imperial_circle_proposal_desc.en: As Circle Leader, lock every member of this circle (including ourselves) into voting against the proposal currently before the Imperial Diet. Votes are locked to the current policy if one is on file, otherwise the circle abstains.

oppose_imperial_circle_proposal_effect_t.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] whip [SCOPE.sImperialCircle('target').GetName] to vote against the imperial proposal.
[SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] whipped [SCOPE.sImperialCircle('target').GetName] to vote against the imperial proposal.

oppose_imperial_circle_proposal_members_.en: Every member of [SCOPE.sImperialCircle('target').GetName] has their [vote|e] in the active Imperial Diet proposal locked to the current policy, or to abstention if no current policy is on file.

petition_imperial_diet_desc.en: As a Circle Leader, petition the Imperial Diet to address a grievance or request.

petition_imperial_diet_reject_effect_tex.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('recipient').GetName] reject [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName]'s petition to the Imperial Diet.
[SCOPE.sCountry('recipient').GetName] rejected [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName]'s petition to the Imperial Diet.

petition_imperial_diet_tt.en: We will request a vote on a policy in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName]

reduction_of_circle_titles_act.en: Perform a Reduction of Circle Titles

reduction_of_circle_titles_desc.en: Our circle has grown inefficient and entangled in titles and administrative positions which are able to block each other. Performing a reduction of the titles would not only ensure the efficiency of our circle, but also solidify our position as leader. Such centralization of titles would not be well received by our circle members, and would lower their satisfaction.

reduction_of_circle_titles_effect_text.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] perform a reduction of circle titles

reduction_of_circle_titles_text_past.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] performed a reduction of circle titles

reduction_of_circle_titles_tt.en: We will gain [ShowModifier('reduction_of_circle_titles')], while every circle member will gain [ShowBiasValue('opinion_reduction_of_circle_titles')|+=2] [opinion|e] of us. The Circle Satisfaction will be reduced by 5.

reform_coinage_in_circle_act.en: Reform the Coinage within our Circle.

reform_coinage_in_circle_desc.en: The Empire has placed authority over the regional coinage into our hands. Implementing a reform of our coin and its usage would help the economic flow of every member in our circle, while also increasing our own standing within the Circle. Unfortunately this would come at the cost of our own mints capabilities.

reform_coinage_in_circle_effect_text.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] reform the coinage of their Circle.

reform_coinage_in_circle_text_past.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] reformed the coinage of their Circle.

reform_coinage_in_circle_tt.en: We will gain [ShowModifier('reformed_circle_coinage_leader')], while every member of our circle will gain [ShowModifier('reformed_circle_coinage_member')] for 5 years. Every circle member will gain [ShowBiasValue('opinion_reformed_circle_coinage')|+=2] [opinion|e] of us, and we will increase the Circle Satisfaction by 5.

request_circle_privilege_act.en: Request a special privilege from the Emperor.

request_circle_privilege_desc.en: Request a special privilege from the Emperor for your circle.

request_circle_privilege_effect_text.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] request a Circle Privilege from the Emperor.

request_circle_privilege_effect_text_pas.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] requested a Circle Privilege from the Emperor.

[SCOPE.sCountry('recipient').GetName] denied [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName]'s request for a Circle Privilege.

request_new_circle_titles_desc.en: Demand the elevation of our country within our Imperial Circle.

request_new_circle_titles_effect_text.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] demand the elevation of their country.

request_new_circle_titles_effect_text_pa.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName] demanded the elevation of their country.
